$comment: The complete vocabulary of the Build surface. Adding a dimension here, with a derive block, is the only way to extend it. No count is fixed: manifest.json lists which dimensions are live in each build (docs/CUBE_SCHEMA.md). derive kinds are documented in pipeline/derive.py; fields are the logical names bound in config/pipeline.json.

datasets.label: Registrations still on the road
datasets.definition: Vehicles first registered in month M that are still registered as at the snapshot date.
datasets.help: Vehicles first registered in NZ in a given month, NZ-new or used import, that are still registered at the snapshot date. Older months are thinned by scrappage.

datasets.label: New registrations
datasets.help: Every vehicle registered in NZ for the first time in a month, including those since scrapped. Never shown on the same chart as registrations still on the road.

datasets.label: NZ-new registrations still on the road
datasets.definition: Vehicles first registered in month M, new when they entered NZ, that are still registered as at the snapshot date.
datasets.help: Vehicles that were new when they entered NZ, first registered in a given month and still registered at the snapshot date.

datasets.label: Used imports still on the road
datasets.definition: Vehicles first registered in month M, previously registered overseas, that are still registered as at the snapshot date.
datasets.help: Vehicles previously registered overseas, first registered in NZ in a given month and still registered at the snapshot date.

datasets.label: Vehicles on the road
datasets.help: All vehicles registered in NZ at month end.

dimensions.label: Powertrain
dimensions.help: How the vehicle is powered: petrol, diesel, hybrid, plug-in hybrid, electric.

dimensions.label: Brand
dimensions.help: The badge on the car. Normalised via the brand registry.

dimensions.label: Manufacturer group
dimensions.help: Who owns the brand. Toyota, Lexus and Daihatsu all roll up to Toyota Group.

dimensions.label: Brand owned from
dimensions.help: The home country of the company that owns the brand today, or for a defunct brand the last company that built it. Volvo counts as China here.

dimensions.label: Brand originally from
dimensions.help: Where the brand was founded. Volvo counts as Sweden here.

dimensions.label: Built in
dimensions.help: The country where the vehicle was principally manufactured. A Toyota built in Thailand counts as Thailand.

dimensions.label: Imported from
dimensions.help: Where a used import was registered before coming to NZ.

dimensions.label: Vehicle type
dimensions.help: Car, ute, van, truck or other. The register records most SUVs as station wagons, so they count as cars.
dimensions.$comment: segment_map matches on vehicle_type + body_type. Where gvm_min_kg/gvm_max_kg are set, GVM must fall in that inclusive range and a missing GVM matches nothing; where both are blank, GVM is not used.

dimensions.label: New or used
dimensions.help: Whether the vehicle was new or second-hand when it first entered NZ.

dimensions.label: Region
dimensions.help: The region where the registered owner lives now, from their most recent address. Not where the vehicle is used, and not necessarily where the owner lived when it was first registered.

dimensions.label: Vehicle age
dimensions.help: Years since the vehicle year. For NZ-new vehicles first registered from 2007 that is years since first registration; for used imports, years since the vehicle's year overseas. Vehicle year is less consistent for NZ-new vehicles registered before 2007.
dimensions.$comment: min and max are inclusive; max null means no upper bound. A missing VEHICLE_YEAR, a VEHICLE_YEAR of 0, or a negative result (vehicle years after the snapshot exist) falls to unknown.

dimensions.label: Engine size
dimensions.help: Engine capacity in bands. Electric vehicles fall in a separate 'none' band.
dimensions.basis: CC_RATING, for powertrains with has_combustion_engine = true in powertrain_map
dimensions.$comment: min and max are inclusive cc; max null means no upper bound. A powertrain without a combustion engine is 'none' whatever CC_RATING says (14% of BEVs record a small non-zero CC). An engined vehicle whose CC is missing or below the lowest min (0, and implausible values such as 1 or 19 cc that appear in the data) is unknown.

dimensions.label: Age when first registered here
dimensions.help: How old the vehicle was when it was first registered in New Zealand. Zero means new.
dimensions.$comment: min and max are inclusive years; max null means no upper bound. Single years to 19 because the moving cutoff and odd-age bumps are one year wide (MODEL_AND_AGE.md section 3). A missing VEHICLE_YEAR, a VEHICLE_YEAR of 0 and a negative result each fall to unknown and are counted separately in the manifest (MODEL_AND_AGE.md section 5).

dimensions.label: Model
dimensions.help: The nameplate, as brand and model. The 300 with the most registrations over the last 12 months keep their name; the rest are grouped as other. Never use submodel, which is free text.

rules.$comment: Shape is inferred from measure + dimension. See CLAUDE.md Shapes.
